title: Valley Towers / MVRDV
summary_en: Valley is a 75,000 m² mixed-use complex in Amsterdam's Zuidas composed as three towers carved by a publicly accessible planted valley and a field of cantilevered apartments. Its form is geology-inspired rather than slab-like, using setbacks, projections, and terraces to produce a rugged massing. ArchDaily also notes that MVRDV's technology experts created custom digital tools for the design and construction process, indicating computationally rationalized geometry rather than a generic mixed-use block.
